title: JANUS Engine R0P1A — measurement data contract for RUN-008
purpose: Freeze the exact channels, signs, units and acceptance rules required before RUN-008 may compute a measured system energy balance.

sign_convention.battery_current: positive when battery discharges to the DC bus; negative when charging
sign_convention.AFPM_power: positive when AFPM consumes DC power as motor; negative when it delivers DC power as generator
sign_convention.export_power: positive when leaving JANUS to an external load

derived_metrics.P_purge_avg_W: sum(E_purge_valve_J)/elapsed_s plus separately reported pressure/gas-loss work
derived_metrics.P_aux_measured_W: P_pump_W + P_gasloop_W + max(P_AFPM_DC_W,0) + P_controls_W + P_thermal_active_W + P_purge_avg_W + measured scale-hardware increments + other declared loads
derived_metrics.bus_residual_W: P_PEMFC_gross_W + battery_discharge_W + verified_regen_W - battery_charge_W - P_aux_measured_W - P_export_W

measurement_quality.rule: Every numeric value entering RUN-008 must include operating condition and uncertainty or instrument resolution.
measurement_quality.transient_energy: integrate timestamped V*I or direct Wh/J channels; do not infer startup energy from one snapshot watt value
measurement_quality.closure: isolated-channel sum and common-bus integral must agree within declared combined measurement uncertainty
measurement_quality.no_interpolation_rule: missing dominant load channels remain UNKNOWN; they are not backfilled from the old 12/10/8 W envelope

unlock_condition_for_RUN008: P0-P6 required channels contain measured data and P7 full-stack bus closure passes within uncertainty.
